classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: one cell per declared comparison-basis component identity, per slice-1 language-role value (TypeScript only), and per that identity's manifest-declared D-002 platforms (macos/arm64, macos/x86_64, linux/x86_64, linux/arm64). Each cell retains a digest-pinned change set of add/delete/rename/byte-change units, the ownership/dependency inputs that selected or skipped lanes, and the four live-cell members for that component × role × platform. An unrelated change does not force every language closure to build (file 02). A skipped platform that the component manifest does not declare is not a waiver of an affected lane; platform scope follows the component manifest. Windows is not a cell. A second language role is not a cell. Path filters, CI vendor config, and cache keys are not the authority that decides impact (file 02 reserved). Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: Every TypeScript × declared-component × manifest-declared-D-002-platform cell is present. A skipped affected lane is not a waiver. Windows is not a cell. A second language role is not a cell. CI vendor/YAML/path-filter authority fails this class.

classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: digest-pinned hostile mutations of declared ownership and dependency metadata, including omitted dependency, omitted owner, missing component declaration, owner outside the comparison-basis universe, and incomplete or invalid universe construction (file 02 omitted dependency/owner detection). Each record retains the presented mutation, the selector's fail-safe outcome (over-selection of every lane that the mutation could affect, or a typed refusal), and proof that the mutation did not silently omit an affected lane. Fail-safe is over-selection or typed refusal, never under-selection (file 02; live waiver cell). This class is CI ownership/dependency integrity. It is not G07 hostile archive/path/loader/TOCTOU, not G10 provider-frame goldens, and not G15 adapter hostile-path emission. Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: A forced ownership or dependency mutation either selects every affected lane or refuses. Silent omit of an affected lane fails. There is no waiver for an affected omitted lane. G07, G10, and G15 are not scored here.

classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: digest-pinned records that a release selects independently qualified compatible bytes through signed metadata and per-surface matrices (file 02). Component release identity and core release identity are independently versioned. Independent releases do not require separate repositories and do not create lockstep versions. A same-version train that cannot emit a component-new/core-unchanged selection and a core-new/component-unchanged selection fails. A bundle may qualify a selection; it cannot be the only release route. DR-117 EE-7e rides this class: the selected TypeScript closure is independently releasable and not lockstepped to the core version train. Window evaluation rides DR-111 and is not minted here. Hostile dual-channel anti-lockstep goldens ride DR-127 / G21 and are not this class. v16 independently spells discriminating cases as IR-1..IR-4 and lockstep discrimination as G16-12; those identifiers are cited-not-applied and are not authored here. Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: Independent component and core identities can release without a required same-version train. Lockstep of the selected TypeScript closure to the core version train fails. Bundle-only release fails. Separate repositories are not required. DR-111 windows and DR-127 dual-channel goldens are not scored here.
